function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH purchase_agg AS (
  SELECT
    pl.period,
    pl.sku,
    SUM(pl.qty) AS po_qty,
    SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS po_amount_cad
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
  WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  GROUP BY pl.period, pl.sku
),
sales_with_channel AS (
  SELECT
    sl.period,
    sl.sku,
    sl.qty AS sales_qty,
    sl.revenue_cad,
    c.channel
  FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
  JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
)
SELECT
  swc.period,
  swc.channel,
  SUM(swc.sales_qty) AS total_qty,
  SUM(swc.revenue_cad) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(swc.sales_qty * pa.po_amount_cad / NULLIF(pa.po_qty,0)) AS total_cogs
FROM sales_with_channel swc
LEFT JOIN purchase_agg pa ON swc.sku = pa.sku AND swc.period = pa.period
GROUP BY swc.period, swc.channel
ORDER BY swc.period, swc.channel","purpose":"Compute revenue and COGS per channel per period"}
